# Sensor Platform

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SensorPlatform`](gmeow-SensorPlatform.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SensorPlatform>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory`](../../slices/sensory.md)

A physical entity that hosts one or more sensors — a weather station, a satellite, a buoy, a drone, a vehicle, or a building-mounted instrument. The platform is situated at a place and carries sensors that observe properties of the environment. Distinct from the [`Sensor`](gmeow-Sensor.md) itself (the observing agent) and from the [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md) (the location).
